arguments.text: Great start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

Plan 10 km (~55 min): race is CP-limited, best is near-even power just above CP (boat ~106-110 W, shaft ~156-160 W), a bit more on legs against the current, a bit less with it, sprint late. 1:00 start at shaft 232 W (1.5x CP), reserve 74% and falling; cued ease at 1:00. Leg 1 (heading N) has current against (push_along -0.28).

arguments.message: shaft power under 140 W for a minute (well below CP)

text: Cued ease (start at 1.5x critical power, reserve falling fast); noted plan; set watches for low reserve and over-easing.
no cue: settled right at sustainable power (shaft 158 W vs 158 W sustainable), reserve 49% and steady.
no cue: steady at critical power (shaft 156-166 W), reserve 46% stable, turn in 52 m.

arguments.text: Current is helping here. Ease a touch, save it for upstream.

9.7 min, leg 2 (heading S) has current WITH us (+0.3 m/s); legs 1,3,5,7 heading N are against (-0.25). Shaft 164 W above sustainable 158, pod reserve 35% falling ~3%/min; cued gentle ease at 9.7 min. Goal: reserve ~30% steady, spend a bit more on upstream legs, empty it in last 1-1.5 km.

text: Cued a gentle ease: with the current, power above sustainable and reserve at 34% falling.

arguments.text: 12.7 min: paddler says 6/10 steady, feels fine at shaft ~160 W (pod CP 156), no fade (+1.5% speed at same rate). Weak hint CP may be underestimated; check again later (cp_implied_w, fade, ask again ~25 min). Pod reserve 31% drifting down ~1%/min. Gentle ease cue at 9.8 min had small effect (164 to ~158 W).

text: no cue: near sustainable power, paddler 6/10 and fine; noted possible low critical-power estimate to check later.

arguments.message: speed at same rate fading more than 2%

arguments.text: 15.7 min leg 3 upstream: shaft ~160 W, pod reserve 24% (boat 18%), falling ~1.5%/min; would empty ~29 min if held. Letting it ride upstream (extra effort pays more here). Plan: at turn ~3.75 km (leg 4, with current) cue ease. Boat ~1% faster than pod predicts on both legs (pod may read slightly low or efficiency up). Watches now: reserve_very_low <12%, fading fade_pct<-2, power_low.

text: no cue: upstream leg, slightly above critical power is the right place to spend; reset watches for low reserve and fade.

arguments.text: 16.6 min: paddler volunteers feeling good and steady. Boat reserve 13%, pod 22%, both say slightly above CP, but no fade (+2.1%). Test: if reserve reads <15% for ~10 min with no fade, CP is underestimated: read cp_implied_w / steady_power_10min_w and use set_critical_power. If fade appears instead, ease.

text: no cue: paddler feels good, steady just above critical power on an upstream leg, no fade; watching whether critical power is underestimated.

arguments.text: 16.9 min: boat reserve 11% but pod reserve 22%. Boat number uses speed minus FITTED current (-0.29) while push_local says current now weaker (-0.22): boat power likely overstated here, so trust the POD reserve more on this leg. GPS 2.76-2.79 steady at shaft 160. Added pod_reserve_low watch (<10%).

text: no cue: boat-speed reserve alarm likely inflated by a weakening current; pod reserve 22% and paddler fine; added a pod reserve watch.

arguments.name: push_offset
arguments.description: GPS speed vs pod-predicted speed, minus fitted current: negative = boat slower than pod power says (more drag, or pod reading high, or local current change)

arguments.text: 19.9 min, 191 m before turn 3: in the last ~30 s pod shaft jumped 161 to 173 W while GPS speed stayed 2.78 and rate 60; push_local fell -0.26 to -0.35 (offset ~-0.07 vs fitted current). Paddler still says 6/10 steady. Suspects: pod drifting high (fits unchanged effort), local current near the mark, or something on the rudder. CHECK after the turn on leg 4: if push_offset stays ~-0.07 (not sign-flipped), it is drag or pod, not current. If speed through water at same effort drops too, try clear_rudder. Boat reserve 0 since 19.5 min, pod 12%.

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts by >0.09 m/s beyond fitted current

text: no cue: pod power jumped with no speed gain and paddler unchanged at 6/10; suspect pod drift or drag, set a watch and will check after the turn.

arguments.text: 20.4 min: pod shaft keeps ramping 161 to 177 W in ~1.5 min with GPS speed flat 2.77, rate 60, paddler 6/10 unchanged. Leading suspect: POD DRIFTING HIGH, so pod reserve (8%) is draining falsely; do not ease on pod numbers alone. Boat reserve 0 since 19.5 min but no fade: if no fade by ~27 min, CP likely underestimated (check cp_implied_w, then set_critical_power). Judge effort from GPS speed, fade and the paddler.

text: no cue: pod reserve alarm looks false (pod power ramping with no speed change, paddler unchanged); holding steady and checking after the turn.

arguments.message: speed through water at same rate fading over 2.5%

arguments.text: 21.2 min CONCLUSION: POD IS DRIFTING HIGH. Shaft reading ramps smoothly ~0.3 W/s (161 at 19.5 min to 196 at 21.2), straight through the turn, while GPS speed, rate 60 and paddler (6/10) unchanged. IGNORE shaft_power, w_bal_pod, push_local, push_offset from now on. Use GPS speed, boat power_w (~111-117 W), fade and the paddler. Removed pod watches and the boat-reserve watch (boat reserve sits at 0 but no fade). Watch real_fade on fade_min_5min. At ~27 min check cp_implied_w; if no fade, set_critical_power cp_w ~112-114.

text: no cue: diagnosed paddle pod drifting high (smooth ramp through the turn, speed and paddler unchanged); switched to GPS and boat-speed numbers and a fade watch.

arguments.text: 24.2 min leg 4 downstream: confirmed pod drift. GPS 3.33 m/s = same as leg 2 (3.33-3.36) while pod reads ~193 W vs 160 then (pod now ~+35 W high, roughly stable). Paddler unchanged. Boat power ~112 W, boat reserve 0 since 19.5 min, still no fade (+1.1%). Next: at ~27 min read cp_implied_w; if ~112+ and no fade, set_critical_power cp_w to it and consider a small push on upstream leg 5 (starts at 5000 m).

text: no cue: paddler steady and not fading; pod drift confirmed by matching downstream speed; waiting for in-race critical-power evidence at ~27 min.

arguments.reason: In-race evidence: steady 112.8 W boat power held 10 min with boat reserve at 0 and no fade, paddler 5-6/10, so test CP 106 W was low. Pod has drifted high by ~22% since 19.5 min (reads ~193-196 W at the speed that gave 160 W before), so shaft CP scaled to match the drifted pod.

arguments.text: Halfway and looking strong. Lift a little on this upstream leg.

27.2 min (4966 m): cp_implied_w 112.8, paddler 5/10 fine. set_critical_power cp_w 113, cp_shaft 196 (pod drift scaled; use 1 of 3). Cued small push for upstream leg 5 (no pace target: pace targets carry through turns). Next: check boat power rises to ~116-118 W, watch fade; ease on downstream leg 6 if fading. Plan final sprint from ~1.2-1.5 km out if paddler still fine.

text: Raised critical power to 113 W on in-race evidence (no fade with reserve model empty, paddler 5/10) and cued a small push for the upstream leg.

arguments.text: Boat has slowed. Back-stroke once to clear the rudder.

30.2 min (5466 m, leg 5 upstream): push cue lifted GPS 2.76 to 2.82, then from ~29.5 min speed fell to 2.72 at constant rate 60 and pod still ~200 W, paddler 5/10 fine; push_local fell -0.34 to -0.44. Suspect weed on rudder (or stronger current). Cued clear_rudder at 30.3 min. CHECK: if GPS back to ~2.78+ upstream, it was weed; if not, compare downstream speed after turn at 6250 m (drag = slower than 3.33 there; current = faster).

text: Cued clear_rudder: speed dropped 3% at unchanged rate and pod power with paddler fine, consistent with something caught on the rudder.
